title: OPDSearch+: On-Policy Distillation with RL Refinement for Search-Augmented Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.24310v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Search-augmented reasoning remains difficult for small language models. On-policy distillation (OPD) from trained teachers offers a promising direction, but suffers from two issues: (1) high-quality multi-turn search trajectories depend on dynamic retriever responses, making SFT data prohibitively expensive to collect at scale; (2) task-specifically trained teachers incur substantial training cost, while directly applying OPD with an off-the-shelf teacher without task-specific fine-tuning constrains the student to the teacher's performance ceiling and suffers from severe training instability. We propose OPDSearch+, the first distillation paradigm that requires no teacher fine-tuning for search-augmented reasoning. translated_title: OPDSearch+：基于强化学习精炼的在线策略蒸馏用于搜索增强推理
translated_abstract: 搜索增强推理对于小型语言模型来说仍然很困难。从训练好的教师模型进行在线策略蒸馏（OPD）提供了一个有前景的方向，但面临两个问题：（1）高质量的多轮搜索轨迹依赖于动态检索器的响应，使得在规模上收集监督微调（SFT）数据成本过高；（2）针对特定任务训练的教师模型会带来大量训练成本，而直接使用现成教师模型进行在线策略蒸馏（无需任务特定微调）会限制学生模型达到教师模型的性能上限，并遭受严重的训练不稳定性。我们提出了OPDSearch+，这是首个无需教师微调的搜索增强推理蒸馏范式。我们研究了将冻结的现成指令模型作为教师模型在在线策略蒸馏中的作用，并揭示了一个关键见解：教师模型重塑学生模型的策略分布，使得后续的强化学习收敛到一个更优的解决方案。
tldr: 本文提出OPDSearch+，一种无需教师微调的搜索增强推理蒸馏方法，通过冻结的现成教师模型重塑学生策略分布，使后续强化学习稳定收敛并提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OPDSearch+, a teacher-fine-tuning-free distillation paradigm for search-augmented reasoning, where a frozen off-the-shelf teacher reshapes the student's policy distribution to enable stable RL convergence and improved performance.
